theories.claim: internal/platform/config/redaction.go incompletely redacts Planning variant and other secret-capable fields before app/web/TUI display
theories.basis: Redact via config.Redact is used by app for both CLI and web (internal/app/config_commands.go:41). redactPlanning in internal/platform/config/redaction.go:54-69 only calls RedactValue for RequirementsModel, CodeContextModel/Variant, SprintIndexModel, TechnicalHandbookModel, AreaReasoningModel, ReasoningModel, PlanModel, ExecuteModel/Variant, ReviewModel/Variant, SmokeModel/Variant – it skips RequirementsVariant, SprintIndexVariant, TechnicalHandbookVariant, AreaReasoningVariant, ReasoningVariant, PlanVariant entirely, so those 6 fields never pass Sensitive check. Similarly redactAgentwrap only covers Executable and Env, not ExtraArgs/Permission fields, and QA only redacts Model not Variant
theories.verification_surface: Contract-security and contract-observability redaction boundary shared by internal/platform/config and internal/app (and indirectly web/TUI projections)
theories.confirmation_condition: redaction.go redactPlanning lists only 10 of 20 Planning fields and misses the 6 variant fields named above, provable by text search
theories.refutation_condition: All Planning variant fields are either not secret-capable by design or are redacted via generic path not visible in this snapshot
theories.inconclusive_condition: Variant fields are proven to never hold user-supplied secrets in this product version
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: Read-only inspection of internal/platform/config/redaction.go lines 54-77 and internal/platform/config/config.go Planning struct; diff field names; verify each variant has RedactValue call
